You can also switch to a different OpenAVC system.
Pick a system from the list, scan the QR code from the Programmer, or enter an address directly.
Make sure this tablet is on the same network as your OpenAVC system.

If this tablet is on a guest or different Wi-Fi network, switch networks in Wi-Fi settings. Some networks stop devices from finding each other: scan the QR code from the Programmer or enter the address instead.

OpenAVC Panel is the touch panel for an OpenAVC system. It needs the OpenAVC server running on your network. Install the server on Windows, macOS, Linux, a Raspberry Pi or Docker from openavc.com, then come back here to connect.
Once the panel is showing, tap the top-left corner of the screen three times to open the admin menu: change server, Panel settings, and the dedicated-panel lock.

The panel previously trusted a different certificate for this system. If you just rebuilt or replaced the server, choose Re-pair to trust the new one.

The panel runs full screen and blocks accidental back taps. A determined user can still swipe to the home screen. To lock the tablet completely, provision this app as the device owner (Android\'s name for a full dedicated-panel setup).
This tablet is provisioned as the device owner. Flip the switch below to lock the tablet to the panel.
The panel is locked to the foreground. Home, recents, and the notification shade are all disabled. Use the triple-tap gesture plus PIN to exit.
Keep the tablet locked to this panel. Takes effect the next time you leave this screen.

To lock the tablet completely, run this from a computer with the tablet connected over USB and Developer Options + USB debugging enabled. The tablet must have no Google account signed in — sign out of every account first, or factory reset and skip sign-in.

This copy came from Google Play, so this tablet has a Google account signed in. Android will not lock a tablet to one app while any account exists, so the command below will refuse to run as things stand.

To lock the tablet completely, run this from a computer with the tablet connected over USB and Developer Options + USB debugging enabled. The tablet must have no Google account signed in. If this tablet was set up with a Google account, factory reset it and skip sign-in first.

Factory reset the tablet and skip the Google sign-in, then either install the app from the signed APK on openavc.com and run the command below, or use QR provisioning, which installs and locks in one step with no computer. The full setup guide covers both.
This tablet is already set up as the device owner, so there is nothing left to run here. Use the switch above to lock and unlock the panel.
The panel locks to the foreground as soon as you leave this screen. Home, recents, and the notification shade are disabled. Triple-tap the top-left corner and enter the admin PIN to get back here.
